name: account-erasure
purpose: An operator erases an applicant on request: no personal identifier remains in accounts, events, notifications, projections or the command log, a rebuilt projection agrees, and the proposal is kept as a business record.

given.text: Quorum is running with a published call, an officer, a chair, an operator, applicants and verified reviewers

then.text: alice's name and email appear nowhere
rebuilding the projection from the redacted log gives the same projection
and still no personal data after the rebuild
p1 is kept as a business record
